name: Plain Light Portrait
description: Flat, unmodified frontal light with no fill or shaping — the plainest, most honest register in the Portrait family — worn by a raw waxed-canvas chore jacket whose material honesty matches the light's own lack of artifice.
subject: person
prompt: a person wearing a waxed-canvas chore jacket with a small woven, blank neck label, real waxed-canvas texture with its own natural sheen and creasing, standing in a three-quarter turn against a seamless neutral-grey studio ground, chest-up to waist-up crop centered in frame, unposed and natural body language, flat unmodified frontal light with no added fill or shaping, true-to-life daylight-equivalent color rendering, natural skin texture with no retouch-grade gloss, no dramatic shadow or contrast, no other people or props in frame, documentary-plain register
